scope: existing Compatibility Farm sources at reviewedFarmCommit only
rulesOfUse: This is a reviewed one-time legacy authority for sources that already exist at reviewedFarmCommit; it is not language inference.
A different live Farm commit must fail closed until this authority is deliberately reviewed or the Farm sources carry explicit packs themselves.
New source onboarding must declare packs explicitly and may not rely on canonical namespace or language inference.
No rule may match more than one pack authority for the same canonicalId.
